commit_message:
[Torch] Convert integral float zero points of PT2E and torchao ops (#25136)

Converts integer-valued float zero points of PT2E and torchao ops to i32
so they lower to LinalgExt. The constant zero-point check moves from the
`dequantize_affine` verifier into the Torch conversion, which declines
constant zero points outside the quantization bounds.

Part of #24862.

commit_message:
[GlobalOptimization] Add target-aware layout materialization

Dispatch-time data tiling assigns layouts inside dispatches, so the
phases before dispatch creation cannot see or propagate them.
Materializing the layouts during global optimization makes that phase
target aware on purpose: layouts propagate through the surrounding
tensor graph, and the packed contractions still fuse with their
epilogues and result unpacks.

Add the experimental --iree-opt-experimental-early-data-tiling flag. It
takes precedence over the other data-tiling placement flags, so
conflicting data-tiling flags are not an error when it is set, and the
route uses the operation families and encoding strategy of
dispatch-time data tiling.

The route applies to modules with a single llvm-cpu target on x86_64 or
AArch64 that uses the CPU encoding resolver without inner-tiled layouts,
and only with the default encoding strategy. For these modules, global
optimization propagates reshapes, normalizes contraction dimensions,
assigns and propagates encodings, and materializes them on the host. It
then records the target on the module, even if nothing was data-tiled.
Dispatch creation therefore skips encoding assignment for the whole
module, always fuses data-tiled ops with their epilogues and result
unpacks, and keeps the loop order of data-tiled convolutions. Other
modules keep dispatch-time data tiling. The enable_inner_tiled check
moves from the CPU encoding models to the Codegen utilities, so that the
eligibility check can share it.

On an Apple M3 Max (local-task, f32, median of 10), the route is within
noise of dispatch-time data tiling for a matmul with bias and ReLU, a
batch matmul with ReLU and a convolution with ReLU. x86_64 has not been
measured.

The optimization options reference documents the route, its limits and
the flag precedence.

The layout decision is split over several passes, supports one CPU
target per module, and adds HAL and Codegen dependencies to the global
phases. The TODOs describe moving it into its own component that decides
per affinity.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
name: pkgci_summary / summary

commit_message:
[GlobalOptimization] Use tensor_ext bitcast for sub-byte packing

- Bitcast packed weights with iree_tensor_ext.bitcast instead of
  flow.tensor.bitcast, the op for bitcasts created before dispatch
  formation. The compiled modules are byte-identical.
- Document in the PropagateAffineQuantization description that pads are
  not moved onto sub-byte storage.
- Correct the comments on the hoisting size limit.
